This page is generated from the control plane's OpenAPI 3.1.0 description (`GET /api/v1/openapi.json`, committed as `docs/openapi/weavesignal-v1.json` in the repository), so it cannot drift from the routes: `just openapi` writes it and `just ci` fails when it is out of date.
Who may call a route, how a refusal looks and what the API promises are in [Control plane routes](/docs/reference/control-api/).

## Routes: station

The station, and whether the service is alive.

### GET /api/v1/openapi.json

**The API's description**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

This document: the API as OpenAPI 3.1, generated from the handlers. Needs no bearer; the description is not secret.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | This document, OpenAPI 3.1. | any |

### GET /api/v1/station

**The station**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

The station's identifier and name.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The station. | [Station](#schema-station) |

### GET /health

**Liveness**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

200 when the service and, if there is one, its database answer; 503 with `status` `degraded` when the database does not. Used by the proxy and the container healthcheck.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Alive. | [Health](#schema-health) |
| 503 | The database does not answer. | [Health](#schema-health) |

## Routes: sessions

Staff sign-in: the session tokens that open the studio's routes.

### POST /api/v1/sessions

**Sign in with a password**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

`username` and `password` for a session token (starts `rss_`). A refused sign-in answers 401 with the same sentence whether the username exists or not, after the same work.

Request body: [SignIn](#schema-signin).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | The session. | [SignedIn](#schema-signedin) |
| 401 | That username and password do not match an account here. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many tries: five failures for a username within 15 minutes, or twenty for an address. Wait for the window to pass. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/sessions/code

**Ask for an emailed sign-in code**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

A station with mail answers 202 for every username and address alike, and sends a code only to an address that belongs to that username's account when it is on, so neither the words nor the time tell a stranger who has an account. 503 when the station has no mail; 422 (`field` `email`) for something that is not an address; 429 when one address has asked ten times in ten minutes.

Request body: [AskCode](#schema-askcode).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | Asked. | [CodeAsked](#schema-codeasked) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many tries: five failures for a username within 15 minutes, or twenty for an address. Wait for the window to pass. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/sessions/code/finish

**Sign in with an emailed code**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

`username`, `email` and the six-digit `code`. Any failure (unknown username, an account that is off, a wrong, used, expired or spent code) answers 401 with one sentence.

Request body: [FinishCode](#schema-finishcode).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | The session. | [SignedIn](#schema-signedin) |
| 401 | That code does not match, or has run out. Ask for a new one. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many tries: five failures for a username within 15 minutes, or twenty for an address. Wait for the window to pass. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### GET /api/v1/sessions/me

**Who the bearer is**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key.

`kind` (`staff` or `station`), `role`, and for staff the `account` and when the session ends.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The bearer. | [Me](#schema-me) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### DELETE /api/v1/sessions/me

**Sign out**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key.

Ends this session. The station key has no session: 422.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 204 | Signed out. |  |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### PUT /api/v1/sessions/me/email

**Set your own sign-in address**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key.

`current` (your password) and `email` (an address, or `null` to take it away): the address your codes go to. The station key has no account: 422.

| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

**Change your own password**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key.

`current` and `new`; ends the account's other sessions.

Request body: [OwnPassword](#schema-ownpassword).

| Status | Meaning | Body |

| 204 | Changed. |  |

## Routes: studio

The studio's view: sources, callers, chat modes, notices.

### GET /api/v1/studio

**The studio's view**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `studio:read`.

Sources in their slots, callers, seats, chat modes, notices, the playout link and the station mode. The studio app fetches it once and then follows `GET /api/v1/studio/events`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The studio's view. | [View](#schema-view) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is an API token without the scope this route needs ("This API token does not hold the `…` scope."); or a staff session whose role may not do this. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### GET /api/v1/studio/events

**The studio's view as events**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `studio:read`.

Server-sent events: one `state` event at once whose data is the studio view as JSON, then one per change; a keep-alive comment every 10 seconds.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | An event stream (`text/event-stream`). | string (`text/event-stream`) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is an API token without the scope this route needs ("This API token does not hold the `…` scope."); or a staff session whose role may not do this. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

## Routes: desk

The desk's switches.

### POST /api/v1/desk/commands

**A desk switch**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `desk:control`.

The same requests as the desk's control socket, without `status`: `on_air`, `mute`, `cue`, `talk`, `talk_to`, or `dump` the profanity delay. Answers with the new studio view. A caller cannot go on air or in cue without their consent to record on file (409).

Request body: [DeskCommand](#schema-deskcommand).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The new studio view. | [View](#schema-view) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is an API token without the scope this route needs ("This API token does not hold the `…` scope."); or a staff session whose role may not do this. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

## Routes: screener

What the screener does to a caller.

### POST /api/v1/screener/commands

**What the screener does to a caller**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `screener:control`.

`screen`, `send`, `back`, `decline`, `notes`, `release` or `drop`. 404 for someone who is not a caller; 409 when the command does not fit the caller's state; `drop` answers 502 when the caller is off air but LiveKit did not remove them from the room.

Request body: [ScreenerCommand](#schema-screenercommand).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The new studio view. | [View](#schema-view) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is an API token without the scope this route needs ("This API token does not hold the `…` scope."); or a staff session whose role may not do this. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 502 | The caller is off air, but LiveKit did not remove them from the room. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

## Routes: room

Room tokens and passes.

### POST /api/v1/passes/end

**End anyone's pass**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `screener:control`.

Off air and out of the cue, the pass refused from now on (across a restart), then out of the room (ADR-0119). Someone not in the room yet (a leaked link nobody has used) is ended all the same.

Request body: [EndPassRequest](#schema-endpassrequest).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The new studio view. | [View](#schema-view) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is an API token without the scope this route needs ("This API token does not hold the `…` scope."); or a staff session whose role may not do this. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 502 | Their pass is ended and they are off air, but LiveKit did not remove them. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/room/tokens

**A room token for one person**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key.

A short-lived LiveKit token for one person, with their role in it for the desk to read. A `listener` token is a monitor that hears every return (ADR-0118): only an admin may ask for one (403 otherwise). A `caller` token records the caller's consent on the station's behalf, against the words the station shows now (`consent`).

Request body: [TokenRequest](#schema-tokenrequest).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | The token. | [TokenResponse](#schema-tokenresponse) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### GET /api/v1/carts

**The banks and carts**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `carts:read`.

Each cart with FILE MISSING. Fetch it again when the studio view's `carts.version` moves.

| Status | Meaning | Body |

| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### PUT /api/v1/carts/banks/{bank}/slots/{slot}

**Put an audio file in a slot**

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `carts:write`.

An audio file as the body, the cart's words in the query. The media worker reads it in its sandbox, brings it to the station's loudness and makes it the cart in that slot.

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | path | integer (int32) | yes | The bank's number |
| `slot` | path | integer (int32) | yes | The slot in the bank |
| `label` | query | string | yes |  |
| `detail` | query | string | no |  |
| `mode` | query | [CartMode](#schema-cartmode) | yes |  |
| `ramp_ms` | query | integer (int32) | no |  |
| `origin` | query | string | no |  |
| `licence` | query | string | no |  |

Request body (`application/octet-stream`): [File](#schema-file). The audio file (any format the media worker reads), at most `carts.max_upload_mb`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | The cart. | [Cart](#schema-cart) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is an API token without the scope this route needs ("This API token does not hold the `…` scope."); or a staff session whose role may not do this. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 413 | The file is larger than `carts.max_upload_mb`. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 500 | The cart wall failed. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/shows/{show}/series/{series}/episodes/{episode}/corrections

Needs: staff: any staff session, or the station key; or an API token with `shows:write`.

|---|---|---|
| 200 | The schedule. | [PublicSchedule](#schema-publicschedule) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### GET /api/v1/public/station

**The station's public facts**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

For a station's own website: the station, the show now, the stream, whether the show is live, whether call-in is open, the video, the zone. No bearer; CORS open to any origin; limited per address. Cached for 5 s.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The facts. | [PublicStation](#schema-publicstation) |
| 429 | Too many requests just now: per address on the open routes, per API token elsewhere. `Retry-After` says how many seconds to wait. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### GET /feeds/{file}

**A show's podcast feed**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

`{slug}.xml`, the show's RSS feed with its episodes. 503 while the show's card has not been drawn or `publishing.public_url` is not set.

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | path | string | yes | The show's slug and `.xml` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The feed. | string (`application/rss+xml`) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 500 | The database or the card renderer failed. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### GET /hls/{path}

**A file of the desk's HLS**

Needs: nobody (no bearer).

Playlists never cached, segments briefly. Only names the desk writes (letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`; at most two levels) are served, and nothing while video is off. The multivariant playlists name the steering route while steering has edges (ADR-0159).

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | string | yes | A playlist or segment, such as `live.m3u8` or `audio/seg1.m4s` |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The file. | [File](#schema-file) (`application/vnd.apple.mpegurl`) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

## Routes: tokens

API tokens for integrations. Admin only.

### GET /api/v1/tokens

**API tokens**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

Every token the station has made, live, expired and revoked, never its secret; and every scope a token can hold, with what it opens.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The tokens and the scopes. | [Listed](#schema-listed) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/tokens

**Make an API token**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

`name` (up to 80 characters), `scopes` (at least one, from the list), and `expires_in_days` (1 to 3650; left out, it does not expire). The answer carries the secret (`rsa_` and 64 hex digits) this once; the station keeps only a keyed hash of it. At most 100 live tokens (409).

Request body: [NewBody](#schema-newbody).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | The token, and its secret, shown once. | [Made](#schema-made) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### DELETE /api/v1/tokens/{id}

**Revoke an API token**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

The token stops working at once and stays in the list, marked revoked.

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | The token's id. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 204 | Revoked. |  |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

## Routes: webhooks

Webhooks: signed deliveries of the station's events to an integration. Admin only.

### GET /api/v1/webhooks

**Webhooks**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

Every webhook with the record of its last delivery (never its secret), and every event one can ask for.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The webhooks and the events. | [Listed](#schema-listed) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/webhooks

**Make a webhook**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

`name`, `url` and `events`. The address must be `https` and reach only public addresses, unless `[api] webhooks_allow_private` is on. The answer carries the signing secret (`whsec_…`) this once. At most 20 webhooks (409).

Request body: [NewBody](#schema-newbody).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 201 | The webhook, and its signing secret, shown once. | [Made](#schema-made) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 409 | It does not fit the current state (or the desk refused it). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### PUT /api/v1/webhooks/{id}

**Change a webhook**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

Any of `name`, `url`, `events` and `enabled`; a field left out is kept. A new address is checked as when the webhook is made.

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | The webhook's id. |

Request body: [ChangeBody](#schema-changebody).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The webhook as it is now. | [Webhook](#schema-webhook) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 422 | The request is well formed but not acceptable; the sentence names the problem, and `field` the field. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### DELETE /api/v1/webhooks/{id}

**Remove a webhook**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

It is told about nothing more; deliveries waiting to be retried are given up.

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | The webhook's id. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 204 | Removed. |  |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### POST /api/v1/webhooks/{id}/secret

**A new signing secret**

Needs: an admin: a staff session with the `admin` role, or the station key.

A new signing secret, shown this once; the old one stops signing at once.

| Parameter | In | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | The webhook's id. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The webhook, and its new signing secret, shown once. | [Made](#schema-made) |
| 401 | No bearer, a wrong one, or a staff session that has ended ("Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again."). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 403 | The bearer is a staff session whose role may not do this: the route is admin only. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 404 | There is no such thing. | [Problem](#schema-problem) |
| 503 | The part of the station that answers is not configured or does not answer (the desk, the database, LiveKit, mail). | [Problem](#schema-problem) |

### Schema: CartCommand

What the studio app asks of the wall (`POST /api/v1/carts/commands`).

One of:

- **`op` is `toggle`**. A cart's key: fire it, or fade it out if it is sounding (keymap section 4).


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cart` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

- **`op` is `fire`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cart` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

- **`op` is `stop`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cart` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

- **`op` is `stop_last`**. `Space`: fade out the cart started last.

- **`op` is `fade_all`**. `⇧Space ⇧Space`: fade out everything sounding.

- **`op` is `cue`**. `⇧` and a cart's key: cue it into the presenters' ears, or take it out of the cue.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cart` | string (uuid) | yes |  |

- **`op` is `clear_cue`**. `Esc`: take every cued cart out of the cue.

### Schema: DeskCommand

A command for the desk; the socket's own words.

One of:

- **`op` is `on_air`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `on` | boolean | yes |  |

- **`op` is `mute`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `on` | boolean | yes |  |

- **`op` is `cue`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `on` | boolean | yes |  |

- **`op` is `talk`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `on` | boolean | yes |  |

- **`op` is `talk_to`**


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `on` | boolean | yes |  |
| `to` | string | yes |  |

- **`op` is `dump`**. Dump the profanity delay (`Del Del`): listeners jump to the live programme, and the delay builds back up. Allowed while it rebuilds; refused only when nothing is held.

- **`op` is `picture`**. Who chooses the picture (video on): `auto` follows the audio, `slate` holds the slate (the desk's F7), `person` holds one camera.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string, or null | no |  |
| `mode` | string | yes |  |

- **`op` is `caption`**. A line over the picture for `ms` (a featured chat message); `text` empty takes it down.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ms` | integer (int32) | no |  |
| `text` | string, or null | no |  |

- **`op` is `now_playing`**. The slate's text (ADR-0010), from what playout says is playing.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artist` | string, or null | no |  |
| `show` | string, or null | no |  |
| `station` | string, or null | no |  |
| `title` | string, or null | no |  |

- **`op` is `mode`**. The station's mode (ADR-0045): in auto mode the video's sound is playout's feed whoever is live at the desk (ADR-0172). Sent when the desk's status says another.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | [StationMode](#schema-stationmode) | yes |  |

### Schema: Period

How long one kind of record is kept.

One of:

- **`keep` is `days`**. A number of days after the record is complete (a recording ended, a call over); 0 is "not kept after the show".


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

- **`keep` is `with_archive`**. Kept with its programme's archive and removed with it (ADR-0039's "A").

- **`keep` is `after_recordings`**. Consent: kept while any recording it covers exists, then `days` more (ADR-0107's "R+42"); until a recording is linked, it follows the logger's period.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | integer (int32) | yes |  |

- **`keep` is `with_call`**. Consent under No retention: it goes when the call's last trace does (ADR-0113).

- **`keep` is `no_limit`**. Anonymous counts only, with nothing that identifies a person (ADR-0115).

### Schema: ScreenerCommand

What the screener (and the presenter, for a decline) does to a caller.

One of:

- **`op` is `screen`**. Open the screening conversation (the queue's selection).


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |

- **`op` is `send`**. Send to the desk (`P`), or send again after a decline.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |

- **`op` is `back`**. Back to the queue (`W`).


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |

- **`op` is `decline`**. The presenter declines a caller sent to the desk (DESK BUSY).


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `reason` | string | no |  |

- **`op` is `notes`**. What the presenter reads: one line, the note, the name on air.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |
| `line` | string, or null | no |  |
| `name_on_air` | string, or null | no |  |
| `note` | string, or null | no |  |

- **`op` is `release`**. Let a dropped caller's held place go (`⇧C`).


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |

- **`op` is `drop`**. Drop the caller (`⌃D ⌃D`): off air, out of the room, out of the queue.


| Field | Type | Needed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity` | string | yes |  |

### Schema: StaffRole

A staff member's role, station-wide (`top-roles-scoped` a). Release one enforces two tiers: `Admin` alone may change retention, erase people, see personal data and manage staff; every role may run the studio. The role is recorded either way, so a finer split can follow without a migration.
